newsitem.title: UK: Fenchurch shares slump ahead of finals.
newsitem.headline: Fenchurch shares slump ahead of finals.

text.p: Shares in Fenchurch, a UK insurance broker, slumped 14 percent or ten pence on Thursday to 60.5p as the stock market got cold feet ahead of full year results due next Friday.
Analysts said a profit warning from competitor Nelson Hurst earlier in the week had not helped sentiment.
Fenchurch shares have fallen 25 percent over the last seven days and more than halved since the midle of May, when it announced its interim results.
At least one analyst said that the recent strength of sterling had prompted him to downgrade most of the small UK brokers. He feared that Fenchurch could even cut its dividend.
The sector has also been hit by tumbling rates caused by an excess of insurers fighting for business.

Fenchurch in February issued its own profit warning that profits in 1996 would not meet earlier expectations with trading conditions remaining tough. The news from competitor Nelson Hurst suggests there has been little improvement since then.
Company executives on Thursday could not imemdiately be reached for comment.
